summary: Verified all weekly candidates independently. Approved four completed, consumer-facing European brand/operator ownership records: Auchan Hungary, Habitat brand rights, Recharge/Recharge.com/Startselect.com, and Bogner. Rejected pending or not-yet-completed items, non-European/B2B-only platform items, uncertain eMAG completion/update items, and duplicate Les Secrets de Loly update.

approved_deals.direct_owner: Auchan Magyarország Kft. / ARHU, 100% owned by Indotek Group
approved_deals.one_line_summary: Indotek Group acquired the remaining 53% of Auchan Magyarország Kft. from Auchan Retail International, moving from 47% to 100% ownership while retaining long-term Auchan brand and procurement arrangements.
approved_deals.ownership_notes: This is a Hungary-level operating-company/control change, not a global Auchan brand sale. Auchan Magyarország Kft. continues to operate under the Auchan brand through long-term arrangements with Auchan Retail International; Indotek Group owns 100% of the Hungarian operator.
approved_deals.approval_reason: Consumer-facing grocery/hypermarket operator in Europe; official Indotek release and issuer-distributed release explicitly confirm the acquisition of the remaining 53% stake and resulting 100% ownership on 2026-06-26.

sources.title: Indotek Group acquires remaining 53% stake in Auchan Hungary, assumes full ownership
sources.summary: Indotek says it acquired the remaining 53% of Auchan Magyarország Kft. from Auchan Retail International, increased ownership from 47% to 100%, and that long-term agreements preserve Auchan brand/procurement ties.

sources.title: Indotek Group acquires remaining 53% stake in Auchan Hungary, assumes full ownership
sources.summary: Issuer-distributed release confirms Indotek acquired the remaining 53% stake in ARHU and now owns 100% of Auchan Hungary.

approved_deals.direct_owner: Vente-unique.com, owner of the Habitat brands in France and internationally except certain excluded territories
approved_deals.ultimate_owner: CAFOM Group, majority shareholder of Vente-unique.com
approved_deals.one_line_summary: Vente-unique.com acquired the Habitat brand rights in France and internationally from CAFOM Group for €11 million after previously operating the brand under licence.
approved_deals.ownership_notes: This is an intra-group brand/IP asset transfer because Vente-unique.com is a CAFOM subsidiary; ultimate control remains with CAFOM Group. The sold rights cover France and international territories except Australia, New Zealand, Canada and Israel, and do not imply ownership of all historic Habitat rights globally.
approved_deals.approval_reason: Consumer-facing home furnishings brand; official Euronext/issuer release states CAFOM sold the Habitat brands to Vente-unique.com for €11 million and identifies Vente-unique.com as a CAFOM subsidiary.

sources.title: Vente-unique.com acquires the Habitat brands from the CAFOM Group to continue its ambitious revival
sources.summary: The release announces CAFOM’s sale of the Habitat brands in France and internationally, with exclusions, to its subsidiary Vente-unique.com for €11 million and describes Vente-unique.com as operating across European furniture markets.

approved_deals.sector: fintech / prepaid payments / digital goods marketplace
approved_deals.one_line_summary: Singapore-headquartered Coda completed its acquisition of Amsterdam-headquartered Recharge, including consumer storefront brands Recharge.com and Startselect.com.
approved_deals.ownership_notes: Recharge’s consumer brands Recharge.com, Startselect.com and Giftcloud continue to operate under Coda following completion. Coda is privately held/backed by investors including Apis Partners, Insight Partners and Smash Capital; no single controlling parent was identified from the completion release.
approved_deals.approval_reason: European, consumer-facing prepaid payments and digital goods storefront; official Coda and Recharge releases explicitly confirm completion and continued operation of the Recharge brands under Coda.

sources.title: Coda Completes Acquisition of Recharge, Expanding Global Reach in Digital Content Monetization and Distribution
sources.summary: Coda states it completed the acquisition of Amsterdam-headquartered Recharge and that Recharge.com, Startselect and Giftcloud will continue to operate without disruption.

sources.title: A new chapter for Recharge: Coda Completes Acquisition of Recharge, Expanding Global Reach in Digital Content Monetization and Distribution
sources.summary: Recharge confirms Coda completed the acquisition and identifies Recharge.com and Startselect.com as multi-country digital storefronts.

approved_deals.buyer: Katjes International via Katjes Quiet Luxury
approved_deals.direct_owner: Willy Bogner GmbH; 60% held by Katjes Quiet Luxury GmbH and 40% retained by the Bogner family
approved_deals.ultimate_owner: Katjes International GmbH & Co. KG, via Katjes Quiet Luxury GmbH, as majority owner
approved_deals.one_line_summary: Katjes International, through Katjes Quiet Luxury GmbH, completed the acquisition of 60% of Willy Bogner GmbH, with the Bogner family retaining 40%.
approved_deals.ownership_notes: Katjes Quiet Luxury GmbH is described as a wholly owned subsidiary of Katjes International. The transaction is a majority-stake acquisition, not a full buyout; the Bogner family remains a 40% shareholder.
approved_deals.approval_reason: Consumer-facing German luxury sports fashion brand; official Katjes and Bogner releases confirm closing, the 60% stake, the direct acquisition vehicle and retained family stake.

sources.title: Katjes International closes majority stake acquisition in Bogner
sources.summary: Katjes International states that its wholly owned subsidiary Katjes Quiet Luxury GmbH closed the acquisition of 60% of Willy Bogner GmbH on 2025-09-01, after German cartel clearance.

sources.title: BOGNER and Katjes International complete transaction successfully
sources.summary: Bogner confirms completion of the transaction, Katjes International’s 60% shareholding and the Bogner family’s retained 40% stake.

rejected_candidates.reason: Rejected for now: the European Commission source confirms regulatory approval on 2026-08-07, and prior EU notice described Naspers/Prosus/MIH as acquiring sole control, but no high-reliability official source was found that explicitly confirms transaction closing after approval and the resulting current ownership as of 2026-08-22.
Rejected as not completed: Partners Group and Eurazeo sources describe exclusivity/contemplated majority acquisition and use conditional language; no completion/closing source found.

Rejected because it is not a European-origin consumer-facing brand/app/platform; the official Instacart source confirms an acquisition, but Instaleap is described as a global grocery technology enablement platform with Colombia/global roots and B2B retailer customers.

Rejected as outside consumer-facing scope: official source confirms Expandi acquired 100% of Kompass, but the business is a B2B directory/data/media/marketing platform rather than a consumer-facing European brand or service.

Rejected update: the EC approval concerns Naspers acquiring sole control of Dante International/eMAG, but the Bulgaria-specific ownership chain and post-approval closing were not verified from high-reliability official sources.
Rejected as duplicate/update-only: an existing completed 2026 row already records Quadrivio Group / Lifestyle Fund II ownership; no new ownership change to add.
